## Overview

::: {.intro}
The 2024 edition of the Geospatial Modelling Workshop — the
programme's first cohort — ran in September 2024, covering
geostatistics and geospatial modelling with the INLA approach, the
same core curriculum as the 2025 edition.
:::

## Course Topic

Geostatistics and geospatial modelling with the INLA approach (same
as the [2025 edition](2025.qmd)).

## Facilitators

This edition's facilitators were the same as the 2025 edition. See the
[Facilitators](../facilitators/index.qmd) page for full profiles.

*Full details for this first cohort are still being compiled and may
be added later.*
